item.title: Races for Saturday March 28th cancelled
item.description: The races for Saturday March 28th are cancelled. With heavy rains falling on the speedway grounds yesterday and again this morning the track is over saturated. Combine that with cold weather and below freezing temperatures Saturday morning, and we will not be able to get enough drying to get the surface into a raceable condition.…
